item.description:
Added

  • Email preview links now open in the default browser when clicked or chosen from the context menu.
  • Register Jetstream as an alternate application for opening .html and .htm files from Finder.
  • Menu-bar actions to paste clipboard email into Jetstream or check its links in the background and copy the full tab-separated Link Report when no links need review.
  • Desktop widget actions to check clipboard links and copy a report, or convert clipboard HTML and copy the selected output. The widget shows the latest report result and offers an explicit link to reopen Jetstream.
  • Desktop widget can paste clipboard HTML into Jetstream's Source tab.

Changed

  • Rename the menu-bar action to Check Clipboard and Copy Link Report.

Fixed

  • Publish the initial widget settings snapshot at app launch so new and existing widgets have current workflow and deliverable content.
  • Keep the complete Settings panel, including its sidebar, within a centered 900-point maximum width.

Added

  • Email preview links now open in the default browser when clicked or chosen from the context menu.
  • Register Jetstream as an alternate application for opening .html and .htm files from Finder.
  • Menu-bar actions to paste clipboard email into Jetstream or check its links in the background and copy the full tab-separated Link Report when no links need review.
  • Desktop widget actions to check clipboard links and copy a report, or convert clipboard HTML and copy the selected output. The widget shows the latest report result and offers an explicit link to reopen Jetstream.
  • Desktop widget can paste clipboard HTML into Jetstream's Source tab.

Fixed

  • Publish the initial widget settings snapshot at app launch so new and existing widgets have current workflow and deliverable content.
  • Keep the complete Settings panel, including its sidebar, within a centered 900-point maximum width.

Fixed

  • Link Report marks the exact approved https://www.facebook.com/esrigis link as "Auto Verified" with "Facebook" underneath instead of reporting Facebook's bot-check error.
  • Link Report action labels stay on one line in a separate, horizontally scrollable action row instead of wrapping in narrow windows, with actions aligned to the right.
  • Copy and Copy Image actions now show a temporary confirmation or error message above the status bar and announce it to assistive technology.
  • CTSS Mail preview branding now follows the workflow: Esri for Calcite, Globe, and Outlook; Maps.com only for the Maps.com workflow.
  • Globe preserves article CTA URLs when an editor adds a Related link in the same paragraph, with each link's URL on its own line.
  • Globe now separates the footer with a solid line instead of asterisks, and avoids repeating footer email addresses as mailto URLs.
